text: Feature 'CustomerID': Unique identifier for each customer. Used to look up specific customers in the database.
Feature 'MonthlyRevenue': Total revenue the customer generates each month in dollars.
Feature 'MonthlyMinutes': Total minutes the customer used in the billing month.
Feature 'TotalRecurringCharge': Fixed monthly charge for the customer's plan.
Feature 'DroppedCalls': Number of calls dropped mid-conversation.
Feature 'BlockedCalls': Number of outgoing calls that could not connect.
Feature 'CustomerCareCalls': Number of times the customer contacted customer care.
Feature 'RetentionCalls': Number of proactive calls made by the retention team.
Feature 'RetentionOffersAccepted': Number of retention offers the customer accepted.
Feature 'MonthsInService': Total months the customer has been subscribed.
Feature 'CreditRating': Customer credit rating from 1 (Highest) to 6 (VeryLow).
Feature 'OverageMinutes': Extra minutes used beyond the plan allowance.
Feature 'DropRate': Engineered: ratio of dropped calls to total minutes — proxy for call quality experience.
Feature 'RevenuePerMinute': Engineered: revenue generated per minute of usage.
Feature 'RetentionEngagement': Engineered: RetentionCalls x RetentionOffersAccepted — measures how engaged a customer is with retention efforts.
Feature 'EquipmentAgeYears': Engineered: years since the customer last upgraded their handset.
Feature 'ServiceArea_Freq': Engineered: frequency encoding of service area — proportion of all customers in the same area.
